latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Editor Job skill for AI-powered video editing and export.
- Upload raw footage up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and receive a polished 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles edit commands like cutting pauses, adding transitions, and exporting final cuts.
- Supports fast cloud processing with simple prompt-based workflows—no timeline work required.
- Includes free token system for anonymous use, with credit and session management built-in.
- Provides clear user feedback, error handling, and workflow tips for best results.
